claims.text: Prompting a language model with three seed instruction examples produces 64,000 instruction examples.
Prompting a language model to rephrase instructions expands the instruction dataset to approximately 240,000 total examples of instructions, inputs, and outputs.

evidence.description: We collect 64,000 examples by prompting a language model with three seed examples of instructions and eliciting a fourth.
This set is then expanded by prompting the model to rephrase each instruction, creating a total of approximately 240,000 examples of instructions, inputs, and outputs.

methodologies.name: Unnatural Instructions Generation Pipeline
methodologies.description: A dataset generation pipeline that prompts a language model with seed instructions to generate and subsequently rephrase instruction-input-output examples.

limitations.text: Instruction tuning approaches rely on vast amounts of human supervision in the form of crowdsourced datasets or user interactions.
The Unnatural Instructions dataset contains a fair amount of noise.
